description: Global Energy Monitor’s Private Equity Tracker connects major private-equity firms to energy companies and underlying physical assets. The provider describes more than twenty firms and more than 2,600 assets worldwide, concentrated in North America and Europe. Records connect fossil-fuel power, extraction, pipelines and terminals to owners and estimated emissions, with upstream holdings sometimes grouped by basin. The tracker page identifies a March 2026 release, while the partner data page separately lists downloadable report datasets from 2024 and 2025. Public maps and report-data links are free under the provider’s stated default CC BY 4.0 policy unless a release specifies otherwise; file formats and the latest downloadable version were not confirmed. A limitation is that ownership disclosures are incomplete, investment arrangements differ, and emissions are model estimates that do not represent each firm’s full footprint. Simulation uses include modelling ownership dependencies and transition exposure. It complements data-gem-global-energy-ownership-tracker with a private-equity focus. No matching first-review draft or catalogue record was found. No files were downloaded and no contact details were submitted.
